title: chromolaena costatipes
intro: Chromolaena costatipes, commonly known as Mexican mint, is a plant species that belongs to the family Asteraceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from various health issues such as fever, cough, and respiratory problems due to its health benefits of anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties. The therapeutic actions of Chromolaena costatipes include acting as a bronchodilator, anti-inflammatory agent, and antioxidant, making it useful in treating respiratory conditions and wounds. Bioactive constituents of Chromolaena costatipes include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
